description: NaIn(GeO₃)₂ is Esseneite structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.86 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.22 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-59°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.78 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one In, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent In, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaIn₂Ge tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ge atoms.
